items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I remember Shane. A young man. [INTERVIEWEE] I'm a young man, Hal.

ctx.x: I used to go up on the Winter Garden. He was Joe Oliver. Joe Oliver played up there. Remember that was Winter Garden.
No, you don't remember. You can't tell that time you remember. And you was a little bit of boy. I was a young man. I was a young man. I wasn't a young man. I remember Shane. A young man.
